title: Akadavidbanks shares a new single, "One night only"
htmlContent:
Akadavidbanks returned with a new single, "One night only," combined with unique sound energy and modern production for an energetic and anthemic release.

The stunning new single "One night only" showcases unique vocal song layers that help build a more expansive wall of sound. Thanks to Akadavidbank's versatility and knowledge to create memorable songs influenced by various musical styles. 

Stream Here: https://soundcloud.com/user-762047109/1night-only

Connect with Akadavidbanks on Instagram.
